---
name: Feature request
about: Something Olympus should be able to do
labels: enhancement
---

**What you are trying to do**

The task, not the API. Olympus has one vocabulary across three doors, so the
shape of a new operation depends on what it means everywhere.

**Which door(s)**

Library, CLI, MCP, or all three.

**Does a backend already do this?**

If some backends can and others cannot, that is a capability question rather
than a missing feature. See the capability matrix in `olympus doctor`.
